description: Ownership map for uBO Lite parity automation. Import tooling may update upstream-owned paths only; Talon-owned paths require explicit human approval.

localExtra.talon-youtube-allow: Talon-owned YouTube compatibility allow rules. This ruleset is intentionally local and must not be removed during uBO Lite parity work.
localExtra.talon-site-fixes: Talon-owned site compatibility rules for customer breakage fixes. This ruleset is intentionally local and must not be removed during uBO Lite parity work.

localExtra.alarms: Talon-owned entitlement checks, community sync retries, and lifecycle reminders.
localExtra.webNavigation: Talon-owned frame-aware reload hints and compatibility diagnostics.

localExtra.web_accessible_resources/click2load.html: Retained for Talon's entitlement-gated custom-filter redirect compiler; current uBO Lite no longer exposes this redirect target from its manifest.

upstreamExtra.zapper-ui.html: Talon does not ship uBO Lite's zapper command or UI.

localExtra.js/offscreen/compile-filters.js: Talon-approved adapter keeps the authenticated request-scoped compiler protocol and durable entitlement-gated registration transaction while using the current upstream parser, cosmetic compiler, and scriptlet compiler.
localExtra.js/offscreen/css-compiled.template.js: Talon-approved fail-closed cosmetic-template guard is preserved across the upstream css-sandbox to css-compiled rename.
localExtra.js/prevent-popup.js: Talon-approved registration reconciliation and normalized popup-mode persistence prevent duplicate or stale dynamic registrations.
localExtra.js/scripting/css-api.js: Talon-owned bounded CSS mutation queue and scoped ownership support live entitlement teardown and recovery.
localExtra.js/scripting/css-generic.js: Talon-owned generic-cosmetic teardown and reload reconciliation are layered on the upstream compiled data.
localExtra.js/scripting/css-procedural-api.js: Talon-owned procedural-cosmetic teardown and bounded mutation behavior support live entitlement changes.
localExtra.js/scripting/css-specific.js: Talon-approved fail-closed guard around the injected procedural cosmetic API constructor. Keep this hardening when importing upstream css-specific.js updates.
localExtra.js/scripting/isolated-api.js: Talon-approved empty-frame-context guards keep compiler-generated cosmetic code fail-closed on opaque or unavailable ancestors.
localExtra.js/scripting/youtube-ad-skip.js: Talon-owned YouTube ad-skip lane. Do not import or copy uBO Lite's YouTube scriptlet/runtime strategy into this path; upstream uBO scriptlets are intentionally excluded from YouTube hosts.
localExtra.js/scripting/youtube-player-guard.js: Talon-owned YouTube page-world guard: leaves YouTube player ad metadata intact, shields targeted enforcement/reset paths, and corrects SSAP restart loops without remote analytics or web-accessible script injection.

upstreamExtra.js/offscreen/fetch-list.js: Talon intentionally omits uBO Lite's imported-list fetch lane; custom filters remain local, entitlement-gated text compiled through the authenticated offscreen request protocol.
